saga: Y1 Steward Hugh the Gray: “The granary counts 40 measures — a season, no more. Plant a farm on open plains.”
Y1 Steward Hugh the Gray: “Every wall and roof to come is standing in that forest. A lumber camp — near the trees, while they last.”
Y1 The raiders have set up camp in the wilds — the Black Fen. For now, it is only a nest of brigands.
Y2 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.
Y2 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.
Y2 Steward Hugh the Gray: “The ground there is spent, and the camp struck itself — the timbers are already home. The land lies open for the plough now. Follow the forest.”
Y2 Steward Hugh the Gray: “You have swords enough to answer the warlord at the tents, sire — if you dare leave home thin.”
Y3 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.
Y3 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.
Y3 Steward Hugh the Gray: “When they mass at the tents, you have time yet. When the camp stirs — you do not.”
Y3 The war-camp stirs — the Black Fen may march soon.

Y6 A warlord has claimed the Black Fen: Warlord Egil Bloodbraid. His banner rises over the tents.
Y6 A rider from Warlord Egil Bloodbraid: "190 gold — or I come and take it."
Y6 Steward Hugh the Gray: “Danegeld. Pay, and the warlord leaves — and returns hungrier. Refuse, and he comes now. There is no third rider.”
Y6 Steward Hugh the Gray: “Warlord Egil Bloodbraid has claimed the nest. His raids will march from there — you can watch that road now.”
Y6 You send the rider back with empty hands. Warlord Egil Bloodbraid marches.
